notes: Tier shelf, no archetypes. String trimmer: old STIHL FSA 110 R and FSA 30 dropped (FSA 50 kept); now 12 market-brand models from the Which? tested list (Best Buy labels paywalled, so no test winners named); source switched to the Which? page. Half-moon edger/grass shears: added Burgon & Ball BoronGreen (Barnsdale test), Spear & Jackson 4811EK, Gardena Comfort 8733-20 from retrieved pages. Artificial turf: dropped the four artificialgrass.ie retailer lines (Boyne, Corrib, Kilmore, Lansdowne); added LazyLawn and Namgrass ranges; TigerTurf as brand only (landscape sold as LazyLawn). Kept old As Good As Grass lines. Lawn roller: dropped for_q FQ-RW (wholesale SKU). Trimmer line and mower blade merged into 'Mower & trimmer spare parts' with no models (STIHL line SKU dropped). Not added: EGO, Bosch, Makita brand entries (no brand page retrieved); Wilkinson Sword garden-tool licence per Wikipedia; Burgon & Ball wiki URL redirects to Malin Bridge article which gives the 1730 Sheffield origin.
